title: Fixed Suspended Seed-Riddle Frame
description: One newly authored complete fixed suspended seed-riddle frame appearance. Four timber uprights on two long ground skids carry two high side rails. Four short inclined metal hanger straps and their exposed cross pins suspend a shallow rectangular tray with a true connected perforated bottom. A long front pull handle with transverse grip belongs to the hanging tray. A separate low open blind receiving pan sits below on crossrails, leaving the hanging gap visible. All whole geometry is new, not an octagonal honey sieve changed to a rectangle, rigid ore grizzly bars or a hose reel with wheels. One static agricultural tool prop, zero scenes. No swinging motion, screening grade, separation, crop yield, food contact, load, ergonomics, manufacture or safety performance claim.
